description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, enabling the setup and configuration of Azure Table Storage-based reminders within an Orleans silo host. It provides multiple overloads of the UseAzureTableReminderService method to configure reminder storage through direct connection strings, configuration delegates, or options.

classes.name: AzureStorageReminderSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to facilitate Azure Table Storage reminder setup.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Storage for reminders, with a specific option configuration delegate.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Storage with options specified through an options builder delegate.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Storage with a specified connection string, automatically handling whether it’s a URI or a simple connection string.
